verdict.rationale: Twenty lists an MCP server on every plan and offers REST and GraphQL APIs over all objects, with a community report that the REST API worked. Emails and calendar events are automatically linked to Company and People records, and the in-product AI chatbot can query and summarize CRM records. Together these cover the core of an agent assembling an account brief, though the full workflow is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: MCP server documentation beyond a pricing-table line, explicit confirmation that linked emails and timeline history are exposed through the API/MCP, and a documented or hands-on account-brief or meeting-prep example.
